name: B10-0534/2025 (PPE) – Post-election killings and the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns the killings of protesters after Tanzania's October 2025 election and the jailing of opposition leader Tundu Lissu. It asks Tanzania to release political prisoners, stop torture and forced disappearances, and hold new credible elections. It also asks the European Union to pause its aid plan for Tanzania and consider sanctions against officials responsible for human rights abuses.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks for action; it cannot order it.
- **Who it affects:** Tanzania's government and officials, detained protesters and Tundu Lissu, and European Union aid to Tanzania.
- **What happens next:** The European Commission decides on pausing aid; European Union governments decide on sanctions.
